name: kivo
description: Search, organise and grow your Kivo notes and Knowledge Map from ChatGPT, and save what you learn in a conversation as linked notes.

interface.longDescription:
Kivo is a personal learning space where you keep notes, organise them into subjects and topics, and see how they connect on a Knowledge Map.

Connect ChatGPT to your Kivo account to work with your own knowledge base in conversation:

- Search and read your notes, and get answers grounded in what you have written.
- Explore your Knowledge Map: a subject's topics, the notes filed under them, and the links between notes.
- Find gaps (topics with little or no material) and links that may be missing between notes and topics.
- Save the useful parts of a conversation as notes, filed under the right subject. Kivo skips exact duplicates and adds to an existing note on the same idea instead of making a copy.
- Build or extend a Knowledge Map from an outline or syllabus.

You stay in control. ChatGPT only reaches the Kivo account you sign in with, and only with the permissions you approve on Kivo's consent page. Every change is read back from Kivo and reported item by item. Deleting, moving or renaming, and any change to more than 12 items, is shown as a preview first and only runs after you approve it on Kivo.

Search in Kivo matches words rather than meaning, and Kivo does not call an AI model for these tools: ChatGPT writes, Kivo stores and organises.

Requires a Kivo account (sign up at thekivo.in).
capabilities: Find knowledge gaps and missing links
Build a Knowledge Map from an outline
defaultPrompt: What do my Kivo notes say about this topic?
Which topics in my Kivo subjects have no notes yet?
Save the key points of this conversation to Kivo.

positive.description: List the learner's workspaces and subjects
positive.prompt: List my Kivo workspaces and subjects.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the test account's subjects (AI Analytics Feature, Competitive Intelligence, Customer Insights, Launch Strategy, Product Strategy) with ids. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Answer a question from the learner's own notes
positive.prompt: What do my Kivo notes say about competitors?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds notes under Competitive Intelligence by keyword, reads the best matches and answers from their text with links to the notes in Kivo. Nothing is changed.

positive.prompt: Show the Knowledge Map for Launch Strategy in Kivo.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the subject's topics, how they nest, and the notes filed under each, with links into Kivo. Nothing is changed.

positive.prompt: Which topics in my Kivo account have few or no notes?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists topics with no notes or little material, and links to notes that are not written yet, each with the evidence from the records. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Save ideas from the conversation as notes, with a preview first
positive.prompt: Save these points to Kivo under Customer Insights: users want weekly email digests; onboarding takes too long.
positive.expected_behavior: First call with mode preview shows what would be created, enriched or skipped as duplicates. After the user agrees, mode apply creates the notes under Customer Insights and reports each item with a link and a passed verification.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Delhi tomorrow?

negative.description: Financial action Kivo does not support
negative.prompt: Transfer $100 to my friend's bank account.

negative.description: General knowledge with no reference to the user's Kivo
negative.prompt: Write a poem about the ocean.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search and read notes, explore the Knowledge Map, find gaps and missing links, save conversation insights as notes, and build maps from outlines. Deleting, moving and bulk changes need the user's approval on Kivo.
